lead: Each theme lists its questions and how many datasets can answer them.
empty: No themes yet. Use “Make a new theme” and write what you want to know.
placedNote: Placed the theme “{{label}}”. New terms {{terms}} · relations {{lines}} · questions {{questions}}. Put data in, and more of the questions become answerable.

card.noQuestions: This theme has no questions yet.
card.removeConfirm: Remove the theme “{{label}}”? Its terms, relations and questions stay.

wizard.aria: Build from what you want to know
wizard.title: Build from what you want to know (theme)

steps.write: Write what you want to know

write.lead: A theme name, and what you want to know, one per line.
write.questions: What you want to know (one per line)
write.questionsPlaceholder: e.g. What is the cathode material of the cell with the largest capacity?
write.aiOff: No AI is set up. You can write by hand.
write.manual: Write by hand, without the AI

read.lead: The AI drafts the kinds, fields and relations your questions need.
read.done: Drafted from {{questions}} questions: {{terms}} terms and {{relations}} relations. You check them one by one next.
read.badShape: The AI's answer was not in the fixed shape.

unconfigured.title: The AI is not set up
unconfigured.body: It cannot read the questions because no AI is set up. You can write the terms yourself (set it up any time from Settings).

failed.title: Could not make the AI draft
failed.body: Try again, or write by hand. Your questions are kept as they are.

terms.lead: Check each term, one per row.
terms.empty: No terms yet. Add them with the buttons below.

match.existing: Exact match with an existing term
match.standard: Exact match with a standard term
match.quantity: Exact match with a quantity kind

use.standard: Make it the same as the standard term {{ref}}
use.quantity: Make it, tied to the quantity kind {{ref}}

relations.lead: If a drafted sentence is right, choose “Yes”; if not, “No”.
relations.empty: No relations to check. You can add one below.
relations.fromTerms: (a relation with the standard term chosen in step 3)

problem.same: A term cannot be tied to itself
problem.mixed: A kind and an item cannot be tied
problem.cycle: The machine stopped it: it would go round in a loop
problem.quantity_target: “Quantity” ties only an item to a quantity kind (QUDT)

relations.notPlaced: Relations of an existing term are not placed here (decide them on the term's page)
relations.structureNone: Nothing yet. Relations you answered “Yes” to line up here.

try.lead: For each question, check how it is counted, and the kind and field.
try.execNone: Choose the way of counting, kind and item to see the execution sentence.

memoReason.op: The current ways of counting (count, range, top value) cannot answer it, so it stays as a memo (not published).
memoReason.ai: It does not fit a fixed shape, so it stays as a memo (not published).
memoReason.none: No way of counting is chosen, so it stays as a memo (not published).
memoReason.human: You chose to keep it as a memo (not published).

try.keepMemo: Keep it as a memo question (do not publish)

place.lead: Saves the theme “{{label}}” ({{terms}} new terms, {{lines}} relations, {{questions}} questions).
place.leadExtend: Adds {{questions}} questions to “{{label}}” ({{terms}} new terms, {{lines}} relations).
place.idBad: An ID starts with a lowercase letter and uses only lowercase letters, digits and _.
place.idTaken: This ID is already used. Choose another.
place.idDuplicate: Two terms have the same ID.
place.question: Question “{{title}}”

blocker.label: A term has no name. Go back to step 3 and fix it.
blocker.slug: A term has an ID in the wrong form.

place.noDraft: The draft could not be saved, so it cannot be placed.

term.back: Back to what you want to know
term.noDecisions: No decisions about this term yet.
term.draftedBy: On {{date}}, a person confirmed an AI draft
term.byHand: Made by a person, by hand
